summary: Tested 3 lifecycle assertions: VAL-CROSS-003 PASSED (results persist correctly), VAL-CROSS-001 PARTIAL (DB records created but K8s Jobs not spawned), VAL-CROSS-002 BLOCKED (cannot test Job state reflection since Jobs are never created). Critical bug: API creates evaluations in DB but fails to create K8s Jobs for execution. Existing completed evaluations (likely from prior testing) have proper results and predictions.
